content.source: AlertRule.MODELLED + AlertRoutes.parseContent (the save also checks the Dataset and the edition)

fields.description: Key columns of the Dataset (a Dataset measure rule only): the Measure is evaluated per key and every breaching key raises its own Alert and Incident. Each column must exist in the Dataset's Schema.
How the value meets the threshold.
Optional human-readable name, used as the title of the Alert and Incident the rule raises; blank = a title generated from what the rule watches.

A Dataset measure rule only: how many consecutive healthy sweeps before its Alert is cleared (the all-clear). Until then a relapse raises nothing new. Default 1 (clear on the first healthy sweep); at most 1000.
true = fire when Files have waited for the Link Analysis index longer than alert.maximumAge (a literal duration). Requires alert.dataset.
The Investigation whose Working Set the rule watches. Requires alert.relation and alert.measure; takes no metric, window or dataset.
The id of a KPI the rule watches (its value to date, or with alert.projection its projection). Takes no metric, window, dataset or measure.

Dataset freshness limit: Ns/Nm/Nh/Nd since the Dataset last published (e.g. 6h, 1d). Requires alert.dataset; takes no metric, window or threshold. Absent = this rule does not check freshness. Instead of a duration, 'auto' (2x) or 'Nxpoll' takes a multiple of the poll interval of the Pipeline named by alert.onPipeline (its feeding Collector).
The batches-ledger metric the rule watches. Required for a ledger rule.
Unique, kebab-case alert rule name.
Restrict to one pipeline (display or normalized name); blank = every pipeline.
The Subject id this rule's alerts are addressed to. Set by the platform to the authenticated author; blank = appUser (unowned: every reader is notified).

A shape an aggregate cannot express, on a windowed Dataset rule (it needs the window block): {type: sequence, steps: [<when A>, <when B>]} - A then B for the same key within the window's size (a tumbling window; no rule-level when) - or {type: absence} - a key that had an event in the slide before a Window and none in it, judged once the Window closes. Takes no measure, comparator or threshold.
A KPI rule only: watch the projected landing (value) or the chance of meeting the target (probability, 0..1) instead of the value to date.
A KPI rule only: fire when the RAG band is at or worse than this; fixes the comparator and threshold.
Which relation of the Investigation's Working Set the Measure is computed over.
The id of a Runbook component. The Incident or Case this rule raises shows that Runbook. A save naming a Runbook that does not exist is refused.
Operator-facing severity.
With alert.by: above this many breaching keys, one storm Alert replaces the per-key Alerts. Default 100.
Positive number; error_rate is a fraction in (0, 1]. Required unless the rule checks freshness (alert.maximumAge).

A named value Measure over the whole Dataset {name, valueCol, timeCol, a window — from + to, or a rolling last: <N>h|<N>d (at most 31 days, resolved in UTC at every sweep) — the Measure's own visible thresholds, and for cashOutConcentration an optional agentList (an Entity List of Entity Type agent)}. The rule fires when at least one entity breaches them; requires alert.investigation, takes no alert.measure.

Ns/Nm/Nh/Nd elapsed time, or Nb = the last N batches (e.g. 1h, 30m, 20b). Required for a ledger rule; a freshness or Investigation rule takes none. A Dataset measure rule may take a block instead, an event-time Window evaluated on each commit of a Stream: {type: tumbling|sliding, size, slide, time, lateness, distinctOn}, size + lateness at most 1h, at most 60 slides, comparator gt or gte.

notes: Three shapes: a ledger rule (`metric`, `threshold`, `window`, optionally `onPipeline`), a Dataset measure rule (`dataset`, `measure`, `threshold`) and a freshness rule (`dataset`, `maximumAge`); `required` below is the example's shape (a ledger rule).
`owner` is stamped by the server on create (the signed-in Subject).
